answers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing for my order in your website, because six week is passed and the box is not come to my address until today.

Firstly, I buy a fishing equipment from your online shop. There was one rod, one reel and a small box for the hooks, and I pay 96 pounds with my card in the same day. In your page it was writing that the delivery is maximum ten days for all the country. But now we are in the seventh week and I have nothing in my hand.

Secondly, this is a very bad service for a big company like you. If you can not send the things in the correct time, why you write ten days in your website? My son and me, we are waiting this equipment for the summer holiday and now the holiday is almost finish. Other customers also write bad comment for your delivery, I read them in the internet after my order.

Thirdly, I want my equipment immediately in my address, or I want all my money again in my card. I am waiting your answer in this week, please don't make me wait more.

Yours faithfully,

Murat Ozden

why_this_band.task_response: The second point is entirely missing: whether the company was called, written to, and what reply was received is not shown, though the task explicitly asks for this, and general frustration takes that paragraph's place instead. The order is also only half described; the amount is given but there is no order number or date.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: The Firstly / Secondly / Thirdly pattern is in place, but under the second heading there is a complaint rather than an answer to the point, so the numbering sets the reader up for the wrong thing. The sentences still proceed in sequence, though, and the letter's purpose is not lost.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Vocabulary does not move beyond order, delivery, equipment; the task's own words such as refund, dispatch, order number are absent. Bad service and bad comment repeat the same pattern twice.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: Almost every sentence has an error: six week is passed, is not come, I buy, it was writing, why you write, holiday is almost finish, I am waiting your answer. Structures are simple sentences; the one attempt at a complex structure, the conditional clause, also disrupts the question order.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Rewrite the second paragraph completely: instead of a complaint, state what was done (which date they called, who they wrote to, what reply came back). Adding the order number and order date would also complete the first point.

answers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about the order number FS-20418, which I placed on your website on 26 June and paid on the same day by card.

The order was a set of fishing equipment: a carbon rod, a reel and a box of hooks, for the total of 96 pounds. On the payment page it was clearly written that the delivery takes maximum ten working days, but six week have now passed and the parcel has not arrived. I did not receive any message about a delay too.

I have already tried to solve this problem myself. On 14 July I called your customer service and the person told me that the order was in the warehouse and it will be sent in a few days. I called again on 28 July and this time nobody answered, so I sent an e-mail to the address on your website. That e-mail is still without answer after two weeks. I also checked the tracking page, but the number of my order does not work there.

At this point I would like the equipment to be sent immediately by an express delivery, or, if it is not in the stock, I would like a full refund of 96 pounds to my card. Please can you inform me your decision until the end of this week.

Yours faithfully,

Murat Ozden

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are addressed: the order is identified with a number, date and amount, what was done is listed date by date, and the request is two-part and clear. The third point comes a little rushed; the expected timeframe passes in a single sentence and refund conditions are not addressed.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: Paragraphs follow the order of the points, and time expressions (On 14 July, I called again, That e-mail) sequence events properly. Transitions run on chronology, and beyond that there is little variety of linking words.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Items suited to the task, such as tracking page, full refund, express delivery, working days, are present. In places such as in the stock and inform me your decision, the article and collocation do not quite settle.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: A relative clause, reported speech and a conditional clause are used, and most sentences are error-free. The remaining errors (six week have, would needed instead of it will be sent, any message about a delay too, until the end of this week) do not block meaning but are countable.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Split the final paragraph: first a single request, then the condition (a refund if out of stock), and a clear date. Clearing up the plural and tense-agreement errors would move the grammar up one band.

answers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about order FS-20418, placed through your website on 26 June and paid for in full on the same day. Six weeks later the goods have still not reached me.

The order consisted of a carbon fishing rod, a reel and a box of hooks, at a total of 96 pounds, and the checkout page stated that delivery would take a maximum of ten working days. No notice of any delay has ever been sent to me.

I have not simply waited. On 14 July I telephoned your customer service line and was told that the parcel was in the warehouse and would be dispatched within a few days. When nothing had arrived by 28 July I called again, waited twenty minutes and was cut off, so I wrote to the address given on your contact page. That message has gone unanswered for a fortnight. The tracking reference I was given returns no result at all, which suggests the order was never handed to the courier.

I would now ask you to send the goods by express delivery at your own cost, and to confirm the dispatch date to me in writing. If the items are no longer available, I would prefer a full refund of 96 pounds to the card used for the payment, rather than a credit note or a replacement.

I should be grateful for your reply within seven days.

Yours faithfully,

Murat Ozden

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are developed, and the second is the letter's strongest part: the date, the duration, the cut-off phone call and the unanswered email build a chain the reader can verify. The request is presented first as a single ask, then as a conditional second option, and even the form of the refund is specified.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: The sentence I have not simply waited opens the paragraph on its own and sets the direction, and what follows proceeds chronologically. Links such as when nothing had arrived and which suggests build the time and result relationship through structure, not ready-made patterns.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Less common items such as checkout page, dispatched, courier, credit note, a fortnight appear with the right collocation. The choice at your own cost sharpens the request; the register never turns harsh anywhere.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: The past perfect, the passive and a contrast built with rather than are controlled; long sentences keep their structure. Errors are rare and do not stop the reader, but the second paragraph reads a little flat next to the others because of its brevity.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Tie the second paragraph to the third and set the promised timeframe against the time that has actually passed in a single sentence; the letter would become tighter and more emphatic with the same information.
